name: game-interface-design
description: Independent mobile-web game planning, core-loop design, player flows, game feel, and optional editable Figma production.

interface.shortDescription: Design game rules, player flows, HUDs and game feel
interface.longDescription: An independent game-design fork: plan meaningful play, failure and replay, visual direction, business hypotheses and implementation contracts. Optional editable Figma output uses local source and verification gates.
defaultPrompt: Design a one-handed mobile web game from its core decisions through player flows and a testable handoff.
Design a merge puzzle with meaningful placement choices, clear failure feedback, and rapid replay.
Build an editable Figma pilot for the approved game HUD and result flow.
